name: Grilled stingray
summary: Cá đuối nướng is grilled stingray, one of the seafood-pub plates on Phan Tứ, with frog stir-fried in lemongrass and chili and a seafood hotpot.
howToEat: The 2019 page names the grilled stingray and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.

In Dong Hoi, Du khách on 29 May 2024, crediting VCT News, says the stingray is rinsed, seasoned, and grilled on foil or a banana leaf, then eaten hot with herbs and rice paper. The price is Check on arrival.
where: Phan Tứ, Ngũ Hành Sơn. The 2019 roundup prints 17:00–24:00. That clock is not restated later.
In Dong Hoi, Du khách on 29 May 2024 places grilled stingray at restaurants by cửa Nhật Lệ and calls it a Đồng Hới specialty. A house number and the hour are Check on arrival.
